evidence.decision: Classifies immediate commands separately from persistent state; assigns roles from consequence and consults alerts for deliberate destruction instead of banning every destructive default.
evidence.artifact: Requires an action contract naming outcome, role/default, hit region and pending/resolved behavior; design, review and adaptation produce different authorized artifacts.
evidence.transformation: Mac photo organizer turns Go into Export… and distinguishes reversible Remove Photos from finishing edits; explicitly checks save semantics before relabelling Close.
evidence.verification: Observable tests cover activation outcome, Return mapping, actual hit geometry, accessible names, clipping and undo restoration; distinguishes static checks from native execution.
evidence.applicability: Separates visionOS visible style from 60-pt targeting and unsupported custom hover/haptics; applies Mac ellipsis and watch placement only in their contexts.
evidence.handoffs: Loads alerts only for consequential confirmation/default decisions and menu/toggle/toolbar procedures only when their action or placement is relevant.
evidence.distinctiveness: Action semantics, ellipsis, Return behavior and delayed iPad activation are consequential button choices that cannot be replaced by a generic component checklist.
